## Summary
Describe the problem and resulting behavior or document change.

## Related issue
Link the relevant issue; use closing keywords only when its full scope is complete.

## Changes made
List meaningful changes and evidence sources.

## Test evidence
Link checks and results. For planning-only changes, report documentation validation; do not claim application testing.

## AI assistance disclosure
Tool, purpose, prompt/provenance link, modifications, and human verification status.

## Outstanding questions
List unconfirmed business requirements, instructor decisions, and limitations.
